# Translator Pro Ai MCP

> Translation and language tools by MEOK AI Labs

`translator-pro-ai-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install translator-pro-ai-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx translator-pro-ai-mcp
```

## Tools

- `translate_text` — Translate text using built-in phrase dictionary. Word-by-word with phrase matching.
- `detect_language` — Detect the language of input text using word frequency and character patterns.
- `compare_translations` — Compare translations of the same text across multiple target languages.
- `get_supported_languages` — List all supported languages with their codes and capabilities.
